rules.when: The task produces a critical design or architecture plan and the work is on the most critical path or is materially ambiguous.
rules.why: The captain prefers Fable at xhigh effort for the most critical-path or ambiguous design and architecture work. If this Fable route is concretely unavailable, use the separate Sol fallback rule.

rules.when: The task produces a critical design or architecture plan, unless the more specific most-critical-path or materially-ambiguous rule applies.
rules.why: The captain's default for critical design and architecture plans is Fable at high effort.

rules.when: A critical design or architecture plan matched a Fable rule, but that preferred Fable route is concretely unavailable.
rules.why: The captain's fallback after unavailable Fable is Sol at xhigh effort.

rules.when: The task ports, wires, validates, repairs, or ships a phynd-cloud TypeScript Lambda from apps/Phynd-APIs into apps/Phynd-Rust-APIs.
rules.why: The captain requires xhigh reasoning for every remaining phynd-cloud Rust Lambda migration lane. Switched from claude to codex on 2026-08-26 by captain instruction after the Claude spend window blocked the View Explorer delivery lane. No model is pinned, so Codex uses its current default model.

rules.when: Reviewing open pull requests, auditing existing changes, or checking PRs for defects without implementing fixes.
rules.why: Use a dedicated Luna worker at xhigh for bounded PR review and audit work so the captain session can remain responsive.

rules.when: New feature design or architecture work, including selecting an approach before implementation.
rules.why: Use Claude Code with Fable for design and architecture decisions.

rules.when: Ambiguous, high-risk, or difficult implementation work, or implementation that Luna could not complete.
rules.why: Use Sol for hard coding, with Claude Code at xhigh as the stronger alternative.
